head: 통째로 보관할 때: 통풍과 습기 차단이 핵심
prompt: A close-up 45-degree angle photo of whole unpeeled onions stored in a loosely woven natural jute mesh net bag, hanging from a wooden kitchen shelf hook near a window. Soft natural daylight streaming in from the left casts soft shadows on the onion skins, showing dry papery texture. Background shows a blurred kitchen pantry corner with wooden shelving. Shot on a DSLR with shallow depth of field, realistic amateur home-cooking photography style, slightly warm color tone, no visible text or labels anywhere in frame.
alt: 통풍이 잘 되는 망 주머니에 담긴 양파들이 부엌 선반 고리에 걸려 있는 모습

head: 자른 양파, 깐 양파는 이렇게 보관해요
prompt: A top-down overhead shot of a Korean woman's hands placing a halved onion, cut side down, into a small clear glass container with a lid, on a kitchen countertop. Bright, clean natural window light from the side highlights the moist translucent layers of the cut onion. The countertop is tidy with a wooden cutting board and a knife blurred in the background. Realistic candid home-kitchen photography, slight steam-free freshness, no text, labels, or measurement markings visible.
alt: 한국인 여성이 반으로 자른 양파를 밀폐 용기에 담아 냉장 보관 준비를 하는 모습

head: 보관 공간별 추천 위치
prompt: A wide-angle photo of a Korean woman crouching slightly to place a mesh bag of whole onions into the cool, dim lower cabinet space of a kitchen pantry, away from direct sunlight and the stove. Warm ambient indoor lighting from an overhead kitchen light, with a cabinet door held open by her hand. The scene shows the shaded interior of the pantry with a few other vegetables softly blurred in the background. Documentary-style realistic home photography, natural shadows, no text or signage in frame.
